input.change_text: **Security:** Fixed `allowManagedDomainsOnly` / `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` being ignored when a higher-priority managed-settings source lacked a `sandbox` block

output.subject: allowManagedDomainsOnly / allowManagedReadPathsOnly bypassed via settings stacking
output.action_text: Upgrade enterprise `claude-code` deployments to 2.1.126+ to enforce `allowManagedDomainsOnly` and `allowManagedReadPathsOnly` even when a higher-priority managed-settings source lacks a `sandbox` block. Pre-fix, IT policy was bypassable via partial settings stacking.
